newsitem.title: JAPAN: DDI group loss seen smaller than forecast - paper.
newsitem.headline: DDI group loss seen smaller than forecast - paper.

text.p: DDI Corp is expected to post a group net loss of about 23 billion yen in the year to March 31, smaller than the company's estimate of a 35 billion yen net loss, a Japanese business daily said on Friday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun cited lower-than-expected connection charges which DDI pays to Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) as the reason for the smaller loss.
DDI, a domestic long-distance telecommunications operator, was not immediately available for comment.
DDI uses its own lines between cities but uses NTT's intra-city networks. It posted an actual group net profit of 4.28 billion yen in 1995/96.
